exposure: Prospective; no trained tokenizers or outcome scores seen
question: Does PA-BPE TICO development fairness transfer to unseen TICO sentences and Books literary text?
prediction: TICO-trained PA reduces TICO Gini vs Classical; transfer could attenuate or reverse. No claim of failure until measured.
scope: Bilingual en/fr 40 web documents per language, 1000 merges; new protocol, not original reproduction. Books first100 contiguous lines is diagnostic; no across-book inference.

splits.ood_pilot: first100 aligned OPUS Books en-fr records; exposed as pilot only
splits.future_confirmation: Unselected TICO test and disjoint Books titles/records untouched

arm_parameters.window_a1: window100 alpha1; deliberate effective bilingual setting
arm_parameters.balanced: Classical dictionary from language-equal multinomial pretoken occurrences at SAME TOTAL pretoken count; seed20261011. One declared simple control, changes distribution not budget.

metrics.primary: Pairwise Gini of language mean token costs over the SAME aligned rows; lower better
metrics.independent: Sorted-form Gini; exact tokenizer-vs-sequential-merge token-string agreement

fairness.information: base/window/hybrid/ratio_dev see same200dev rows; ratio_equal/ordinary/unsupervisedbalanced see no dev. Report this difference; no outcome-driven tuning.
fairness.tokenization: Underlying tokenizers BPE with native training pretokenizer Whitespace→ByteLevel(use_regex=False), full byte alphabet, no special tokens. Explicitly adapted scorer, not unverified author HF wrapper.
fairness.cost: same mergecount/word boundary rules; record runtime/RSS, no timing superiority due sharedhost
fairness.stopping: If vocab mismatch or scorer validation fails, no ranking until correction; do not change frozen results silently

outcome_rules.support_failure: I_TICOtest>0 and I_Books<=0 is diagnostic failure; attenuation I_TICOtest-I_Books>0 motivates mechanism only
outcome_rules.no_failure: positive Books gain without adequate independent domains does not prove global robustness
outcome_rules.inconclusive: small sample, unequal vocab, invalid score or conflicting tradeoffs; retain negatives

statistics: Descriptive pilot only; no p-values from dependent first100book lines. Preserve paired costs and row IDs for later grouped uncertainty.
remaining: thirdlanguage and wider domain/book coverage, matched informative simple pooled/domain-swap controls, mechanism-based candidate and independent confirmation
